scenarios.name: Assessment before update
given: An existing JSON file is provided for update
then: assess-practice.py is run first to determine suggestedUpdateMode
The update mode is auto-fix, remap, light-reanalysis, or full-reanalysis based on assessment output

scenarios.name: Backup before overwrite
given: The update will overwrite existing files
when: Any mode (auto-fix, remap, light-reanalysis, or full-reanalysis) begins
then: backup-practice.py has created a timestamped backup of the directory
The backup contains all JSON and markdown files

scenarios.name: Auto-fix mode applied when sufficient
then: Fix utilities are run without user interaction
Re-assessment confirms 0 errors before reporting success

scenarios.name: Dependency resolution before update
given: An extension practice is being updated
then: discover-dependencies.py resolves all baselinePracticeName and practiceDependencyNames
Resolved dependencies are confirmed with the user before proceeding

scenarios.name: Content preservation during remap
when: Existing content is extracted and remapped
then: All valid existing alphas, activities, work products, and narratives are preserved
Only superseded or invalid content is replaced

scenarios.name: Post-update validation required
then: eval-skill-output.py is run with error_pass_rate checked
The result is reported to the user with any remaining warnings

scenarios.name: Comparison report after update
given: A remap, light-reanalysis, or full-reanalysis update has completed
then: diff-practice-json.py shows what changed vs the original
The user sees added, removed, and modified elements

scenarios.name: User confirms update mode when auto-fix insufficient
then: The user is asked to choose between remap, light-reanalysis, and full-reanalysis
The recommended mode and reason from assessment are presented

scenarios.name: ChangeRequest generated after update
given: An update has modified an existing practice/baseline/method JSON
when: The updated JSON differs from the backup version
then: generate-change-request.py produces a ChangeRequest JSON
The ChangeRequest is written to the practice directory
A Downstream Impact Report is presented to the user listing affected practices

scenarios.name: Downstream impact report presented
given: A ChangeRequest has been generated with operations and nameChanges
then: The user is shown each dependent practice name, path, and role
Each nameChange affecting that dependent is listed
Each dependent is classified as auto-propagatable or manual remap needed
The user is told which practices need /update-method remap vs auto-fix

scenarios.name: Downstream auto-propagation requires confirmation
then: A dry-run is shown to the user first
Changes are only applied after user confirms

scenarios.name: Content preservation during light reanalysis
given: The update uses light reanalysis mode (Phase 1B → 2 → 3)
when: Sections are classified as PRESERVE or UPDATE based on user scope
then: PRESERVE sections appear verbatim in the updated analysis report
UPDATE sections retain valid existing entries as baseline
New content is traceable to source materials or the stated change context

scenarios.name: Re-verification is scoped to changed elements
given: An update has modified a practice, method or baseline JSON
then: diff-practice-json.py has produced the changed-element list
Each verifier brief is scoped to those elements rather than the whole document
Only the gates for phases the update touched are run
Any fix applied in response to a finding is followed by rebundling
